dedupe_keys.name: the development of stationary battery storage systems in germany a market review database

description: This Mendeley Data deposit is a database of large stationary battery storage systems in Germany assembled for a market review by Peter Stenzel, Jochen Linssen, Martin Robinius and Detlef Stolten at Forschungszentrum Juelich. Each entry records location, installed capacity, installed power, investment, battery technology, commissioning date, operational status, area of application and further information. Data collection began in 2012 and covers operational and planned systems, compiled from press releases, regulatory filings and direct contact with project stakeholders. Coverage is national at installation level, published on 18 March 2020 as version 1. The record offers a download, free of charge, under the non-commercial licence CC BY NC 3.0, and the file formats are not described on the page. Caveats: the authors note that some projects are missing, the data stop in 2020 and there is no update plan. It suits capacity planning and storage scenario building for the German grid. Related catalogue record: data-battery-charts-germany-stationary-storage, a live German storage register.
